sources.title: R5RS Scheme map and for-each
sources.version_or_date: section of the R5RS HTML edition generated 1999-05-19
sources.confirmed: Multiple-list map requires equal lengths and combines corresponding elements. For-each uses ordered calls for side effects; map's dynamic call order is unspecified.
sources.limits: R5RS requires equal lengths but does not specify automatic mismatch rejection here; its list-only interface needs adaptation. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C07.json.

sources.title: Common Lisp sequence map
sources.version_or_date: Common Lisp the Language, second edition, 1990
sources.sections_read: map and map-into within Concatenating, Mapping, and Reducing Sequences.
sources.confirmed: Map combines corresponding positions, stops at the shortest input, and preserves callback order. Map-into documents the same termination policy for lists and vectors.
sources.limits: Python's index-and-end-exception protocol still needs an adapter; these sources do not validate that integration. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C07.json.

sources.title: Common Lisp LOOP with multiple iteration clauses
sources.version_or_date: 1990 second edition; includes March 1989 syntax correction
sources.sections_read: Multiple for/as clauses, and, list traversal, vector traversal, and termination.
sources.confirmed: Multiple iteration clauses share one loop body; a clause reaching its endpoint can terminate the loop. The text distinguishes sequential stepping from and-linked parallel stepping.
sources.limits: Transferring this design adds syntax and stepping-order rules; it is not a ready adapter for Python user-defined sequences. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: pre_decision. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C07.json.
